result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per rolling 12-month period, at least 30 days’ written notice, during business hours, through an independent auditor subject to confidentiality, with no direct or remote systems access. Section 22.2 retains the required cost allocation, including the 5% threshold. The edits are targeted, preserve the existing payment and information-protection provisions, and are professionally drafted, notwithstanding minor duplication of the systems-access prohibition.
